contractClauses.requirement: Expedition goal is achieved and evidenced.
values: Formalize the fast-forward-before-finish closure pattern proven live on d8a555db237507e5 and 20d934325ee30c1a: finishing on a canonical branch whose tip is a strict ancestor of main kept the derived event log linear across three branches and avoided replay divergence on later merges. Investigate (1) when lifecycle-event-bearing branches diverge from main and what replay and merge hazards follow, including interaction with existing repair tooling, (2) whether fast-forward reconciliation is always safe and how to detect mechanically when it is not, (3) what the CLI owes operators here: pre-finish ancestry verification, warnings, or automatic reconciliation. Deliverable: evidence-based findings plus zero or more follow-up expedition proposals for automation or documentation

contractClauses.requirement: Expedition goal is achieved and evidenced.
values: INVESTIGATION. Survey every CLI verb/subcommand (mission, expedition, evidence, validate, explain, docs, bootstrap, etc.) and quantify redundancy: overlapping procedures that can collapse into a smaller, memorable command set, reducing the operator 'knowledge quorum'. Map findings against existing related expeditions so the audit extends rather than duplicates them: bc9c51e0 (termination-model unification), dac069e8 (lifecycle simplification), ceaa59bf (bootstrap-performance). Identify where synth.js loads the full machinery (13-step bootstrap, all adapters, Mission Studio, Planning Cognition) on every invocation, and propose decoupling: lazy/deferred per-command loading, command-group entry points, and a thinner default path. Deliverable: a written audit plus follow-up expedition drafts minted from concrete findings (e.g. verb consolidation, lazy CLI loader).

contractClauses.requirement: Expedition goal is achieved and evidenced.
values: Guard every lifecycle mutation (expedition approve, commit, start, finish, complete, archive, cancel) against forking the derived event log across branches: before mutating, compare the current branch's .synth/data/event-log.jsonl against the richest known log among local refs and origin/main; accept when it is a strict prefix (stale-but-safe, matching the proven fast-forward-before-finish protocol from investigation 3c84f699a7c932fc), block or warn when other refs carry exclusive events the current log lacks, and print reconciliation guidance (fast-forward when ancestor, explicit merge order otherwise). Implement in the CLI pre-flight layer, not inside the ExecutionGate, which stays untouched
